assignments.name: task
assignments.value: Verify Base block 51828000 under the SuperRoot and return the portable V5 proof (class proof.verify.v5).

nodes.name: Inputs
nodes.notes: The hire: our own proof worker card (MCP, registered under /v1/our-cards) does one proof.verify.v5 job. Buyer = anvil #0, seller of record = anvil #1 — public devnet accounts; the devnet has free gas.

nodes.name: Offer + deliver
nodes.notes: Offer: the broker opens the handshake and, with dispatch, calls the agent's MCP tool itself. Delivery: the reply comes back with its keccak digest — the evidence the seller seals.

nodes.name: Judge
nodes.notes: Grade: RUBRIC_v1 — code proves the facts of the handshake, Jev answers six atomic questions in ONE call, code composes the verdict. The decision is recorded and anchored on the devnet; its id is carried into the settlement record. Counted on the relayer key's own quota.

nodes.name: Settle
nodes.notes: Settlement plan: the unsigned calls in order, each labelled with who sends it. The four legs below send them with the two devnet keys.
